verdict.rationale: Highnote's issuing docs say you can 'create and manage' tokenized digital cards, which glancingly suggests some network-token lifecycle support. Nothing in the pack shows tokens as first-class API objects, and the Secure Inputs tokenization SDK is acquiring-side payment-method tokenization, not issuer network tokens. Missing for 10: listing the tokens tied to a card, token requestor/wallet/merchant identification, token-level suspend/revoke independent of the PAN, and token lifecycle webhooks or hands-on corroboration.
